name: dsh-advisor
description: Local dsh advisor plugin: cross-provider second opinions. Registers the `consult` model tool (F3/F4), an OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint on the existing web port (F2, Bearer token from settings.yaml), DSH_MODEL=provider/model main-agent rerouting via the agent/request waterfall (F1), upstream route reporting (F5) and a JSONL audit trail (F6).
